importExport.title: Import and export
importExport.exportHint: A CSV of all products. The cost column is only included for those who may see it.
importExport.importHint: A CSV with a header row. Basics: sku, slug, brand, category (the category slug), name_uk, name_en, price, compare_at_price, cost_price, weight_grams. Content: short_description, description, composition, care, meta_title and meta_description, each with _uk and _en. A product is matched by sku: it is updated if it exists (an empty cell changes nothing and never deletes a text: use the product card to clear one) and created as a draft if not. Text is plain text: a line break starts a paragraph and anything in angle brackets is dropped. Photos, their alt text, sizes, colours and stock are added in the product card afterwards; a CSV product stays a draft until then. Up to 2 MB and 1000 rows. Download the template for the exact header; in Excel use Data, From Text/CSV, UTF-8.

notes.codExcluded: Cash on delivery is not counted: nothing is captured until the carrier's remittance is recorded (owner queue Q85).
notes.giftCardsExcluded: Gift cards are not revenue; payments and refunds made with them are left out.
notes.untimed: Some money rows have no time and belong to no period. Tell the developer.
notes.ordersByCreation: Orders are dated by the day they were created.
notes.notRevenue: Ordered value of orders that are not cancelled; it is not revenue.
notes.stockNow: Stock as it is now, not for a period.
notes.returnRateCohort: Requests created in the period divided by orders paid in the same period; the two groups are not the same orders.
notes.customersByCapture: A customer is new when their first captured payment falls in the period. Customers are the mailbox, lower-cased.
notes.topLifetime: The best customers are by lifetime net receipts (captured minus refunded), not only this period. The key opens the customer card.
notes.successRateSettled: Success rate = succeeded / (succeeded + failed); attempts still open are not counted.
notes.viewsAreSessionDays: A view is one session on one day (UTC date).
notes.noConversion: This is a list of products, not a conversion figure: views and purchases are not linked.
notes.marginEvents: Margin follows events: a sale in the period of its first capture, a cancellation or a received return in the period it happens.
notes.goodsOnlyBreakdown: The rows are goods margin; the carrier cost is only in the figure above the table.
notes.noCostLines: Lines sold without a cost snapshot are left out of the margin and counted separately.
notes.noShippingCost: Some seller-paid orders have no carrier cost yet; their shipping is left out.
